boosters.title: Want or plan?

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: A want and a plan can use the same action. Listen.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: Quiero salir. Voy a salir.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: I want to go out. I am going to go out.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: Voy a comer.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: What is this person saying?

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: They are going to eat. That's a plan.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: Quiero dormir.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: Keep sleeping as the action, but make it a plan.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: Voy a dormir.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: Now say one thing you want to do, then one thing you plan to do. Your answers can be fictional.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: We'll check a fresh example next. You don't need to repeat the whole Arc.

boosters.retest_policy: Choose unused changed-context item AFTER the instructional Booster; never score the just-revealed model as fresh readiness. If uncertain or unsuccessful, offer support/stop rather than looping.

boosters.title: Have or have to?

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: Listen for the little word that changes having into an obligation.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: Tengo tiempo. Tengo que esperar.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: I have time. I have to wait.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: Tengo que comer.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: What is this person saying?

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: They have to eat. We aren't just naming something they have.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: You have to go out. Say that in Spanish.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: Tengo que salir.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: Choose a different familiar action. Say you have to do it.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: We'll check a fresh obligation next. The things you've already shown stay recorded.

boosters.retest_policy: Choose unused changed-context item AFTER the instructional Booster; never score the just-revealed model as fresh readiness. If uncertain or unsuccessful, offer support/stop rather than looping.

boosters.title: Can or cannot?

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: This is about what is possible, not what someone wants.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: Puedo ayudar. No puedo ayudar.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: I can help. I can't help.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: No puedo esperar.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: What is this person saying?

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: They cannot wait. That doesn't tell us whether they want to wait.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: Puedo salir.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: Keep going out as the action, but say that you cannot.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: No puedo salir.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: Choose something you can do. Say it. Then choose something you cannot do right now.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: Next we'll use a new situation, without the answer in front of you.

boosters.retest_policy: Choose unused changed-context item AFTER the instructional Booster; never score the just-revealed model as fresh readiness. If uncertain or unsuccessful, offer support/stop rather than looping.

boosters.title: Keep the action form

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: Change the frame. Keep the action form. Listen to comer.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: Quiero comer. Tengo que comer. Voy a comer.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: The first part changes the intention. The action stays comer after these frames.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: Say you want to sleep.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: Quiero dormir.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: Now make that a plan.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: Voy a dormir.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: You have to help. Say it.

steps.speaker: spanish
steps.text: Tengo que ayudar.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: We'll use a different action in the fresh check. A model you just repeated is useful practice, not yet proof of recall.

boosters.retest_policy: Choose unused changed-context item AFTER the instructional Booster; never score the just-revealed model as fresh readiness. If uncertain or unsuccessful, offer support/stop rather than looping.
